summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an Appendix 3G notifying ASX of the issuance of 5,862,567 unquoted performance rights under its employee incentive scheme to CEO Michael O'Kronley on May 5, 2026. No consideration, price, premium, or board recommendation was disclosed. This is a routine equity grant for management compensation, not a special situation involving acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring. The filing serves as a foreign private issuer notification of standard employee equity grants. No deal terms apply.
